intent: Route container, standalone OnPush, selector app-dashboard-page. Injects DashboardStore and BiometricTelemetryService only. On init calls DashboardStore.load(); computes ViewState (loading|error|empty|success) per region. Template renders the seed grid verbatim in a CSS grid with named areas, binding: app-biometric-tiles (BiometricTilesComponent selector app-biometric-tiles { metric = input.required<BiometricMetric | null>(); state = input<ViewState>('success') }) in tiles; app-comparison-split-bars (ComparisonSplitBarsComponent selector app-comparison-split-bars { ratios = input.required<readonly TrainingRatio[]>(); state = input<ViewState>('success'); resetRequested = output<void>() }, resetRequested -> store.resetRatios()) in bars; app-radial-gauges (RadialGaugesComponent selector app-radial-gauges { phases = input.required<readonly PhaseProgress[]>(); state = input<ViewState>('success') }) in gauges; app-chevron-stepper (ChevronStepperComponent selector app-chevron-stepper { phases = input.required<readonly PhaseProgress[]>(); state = input<ViewState>('success'); activePhaseId = input<string | null>(null); phaseSelected = output<string>() }) in timeline; app-step-card-list (StepCardListComponent selector app-step-card-list { steps = input.required<readonly WorkoutStep[]>(); state = input<ViewState>('success'); selectedStepId = input<string | null>(null); showActions = input<boolean>(false); stepSelected = output<string>(); stepCompleted = output<string>() }) in steps; app-statistics-bar (StatisticsBarComponent selector app-statistics-bar { metric = input.required<BiometricMetric | null>(); state = input<ViewState>('success') }) in stats. Contracts: DashboardStore (providedIn root) { readonly ratios: Signal<readonly TrainingRatio[]>; readonly phases: Signal<readonly PhaseProgress[]>; readonly steps: Signal<readonly WorkoutStep[]>; readonly loading: Signal<boolean>; readonly error: Signal<string | null>; load(): void; resetRatios(): void } ; BiometricTelemetryService (providedIn root) { readonly metric: Signal<BiometricMetric | null>; readonly loading: Signal<boolean>; readonly error: Signal<string | null>; loadSnapshot(): void; startStream(): void; stopStream(): void } .
